title: ACL
shortDescription: Managing the configuration of access control list (ACL) rules for buckets and objects
metaDescription: All available methods for working with access control lists (ACL) for VK Object Storage buckets and objects: set a bucket ACL (PutBucketACL) or an object ACL (PutObjectACL); get a bucket ACL (GetBucketACL) or an object ACL (GetObjectACL)
